post.summary:
Commercial roll-up door giving your Miami business trouble? A door that won't stay open, rubs against its guides, hangs crooked or makes the operator strain is usually asking for service, and waiting tends to mean more downtime later. Salt air and humidity along the coast, plus the occasional forklift bump, wear on guides and hardware.

Between visits, a building manager can safely watch a full open-and-close cycle, look for dents or loose fasteners, keep the opening clear and test safety edges and photo-eyes. Springs, brackets and the tension wheel should be left to a trained technician.

Our new guide walks through the warning signs, a simple checklist for your team and how to think about repair versus replacement for warehouses, shops and loading bays. 305 Doors services commercial garage doors in Miami. Tap Learn more to read it.
